initial_prompt:

Same naturalistic painted adult Chinese royal woman style, refined face and hands, luminous restrained shading, no facial hair. All four Queens share the same rich clothing palette; do not recolor the whole woman by suit.
Preserve the narrow gold lotus-vine outer frame, beaded inner rules, ivory margin and diagonal ivory index panels; dense teal/red/ivory/gold Chinese lotus ornament on BLACK interior ground, shaped ivory reserve with fine gold tracery, diagonal woven waist join and SMALL turquoise jewel at exact card center. Retain motif scale and density; no empty background or enlarged figure. Crown and every attribute safely inside the inner frame.
Exactly two opposing waist-up portraits of the SAME woman, with the bottom a precise 180-degree rotated counterpart of the upper. Same face, crown, hands, flower, robe, ornament and index under a half turn. Natural diagonal central join. Two hands per upright figure, graceful correct fingers; no extra inherited hands or staff parts.
Change the two corner indices to serif Q and the specified small PLAIN SOLID suit symbol, keeping the letter size, clear Q tail, panel positioning and rotated lower copy. No K letters, no names, captions or other text. One flat full-card PNG approximately 1060x1484, no mockup, other cards, scene, border-crossing ornaments, photo, anime, 3D or watermark.

HEARTS: Change ONLY the outer border's ground from black to MADDER LAKE RED #A73443, keeping the same gold vines. The interior floral ground remains BLACK. Red Q and plain red HEART indices.
Distinct warm thoughtful adult Chinese face, softly oval features and gently arched brows, face gently turned toward VIEWER'S LEFT with BOTH EYES visible, never profile. Give her a softly rounded compact phoenix crown profile with fine pearl clusters and small rounded red gems, delicate pearl earrings and smooth upswept black hair. Retain the distinctly Chinese crown, no European hood or veil.
REMOVE the scepter completely, including its grip, finial and hanging ornaments. Instead, in the hand on viewer's RIGHT, hold one small fresh CREAM-AND-MADDER ROSE with rounded overlapping petals on a slender natural green stem and two small leaves. Blossom at shoulder level, roughly 6–7% of card width, no bigger than her hand. Clearly a living rose, not a staff, giant bouquet or jeweled finial. Her fingers gently pinch the thin green stem; the stem continues a little below the hand. Other hand lightly gathers the upper robe. Preserve the exact graceful sleeve width, head scale, deep red phoenix robe, teal embroidered bands and floral surroundings. Repeat the identical rose and woman upside down in the lower half.
